top: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever;
bottom: thy throne from generation to generation.

top: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman
bottom: ...therefore hear the word at my mouth...

top: ...and the house was filled with the cloud,
bottom: ...full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.

top: ...and I will put a new spirit within you;
bottom: and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh...

top: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant...
bottom: ...and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

top: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth...

bottom: ...so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
